checks.message: Provisional boundary in use (official_boundary=false, provisional_constraint). Disclosed in proposal.md (前置条件披露 section), visual/index.html (status-box + 自检卡) and this self_check.json; NOT an official redline, NOT a precise area basis, NOT an approval basis. known_blockers cleared; recalculation after official redline release tracked in manifest.next_actions. All area metrics rounded to 2 significant figures.

Three key areas are provisional polygons (official_boundary=false). Same disclosure chain as BOUNDARY_TRUST: proposal.md / visual/index.html / self_check.json. NOT official key-area redline; recalculation tracked in manifest.next_actions. Site-specific evidence (现状诊断, 空间动作, 实施依赖) for each key area provided in proposal.md.
Land-use polygons derived from provisional boundary partitioning. 9 land-use categories covering full site extent.
Static HTML visualization generated without external dependencies. A3/A0 PDFs regenerated with improved layout (title spacing, legends, font sizes, provisional warning prominence).

Proposal includes per-requirement evidence in compliance_matrix.json, 8 global case studies, 3 test validation scenarios with operation matrix, 3 AI landmarks, brand identity system, component library, annual event system, developer community operations, cultural fusion narrative, signage system, international communication plan, and site-specific evidence for 3 key areas. Scaffold language removed; data_confidence=low in manifest.
